register: Informal-polite 你 throughout: the catalog is split exactly 258 to 258 strings between 你 and 您, Apple and Google Taiwan consumer apps address the reader as 你, and the Simplified catalog was standardized on 你 too, so 您 strings and strings mixing 你/您 are flagged (low). Buttons and menu items are bare verb or noun phrases (新增網站, 儲存), sentences end in full-width 。, and 請 is fine for instructions.

avoid: 報導 (when it means a NewsBlur story)
新聞 (when it means a NewsBlur story)
terms.note: Catalog majority (about 970 strings). 故事 reads as 'tale', 報導 as 'news report'. Counter: N 篇文章. 'News coverage' or 'widely covered topics' may stay 報導. Also avoid where it means this concept: 故事.
Counter: N 個網站. 'site-wide' → 全站.

The catalog mixes 資訊來源 (134), 動態消息 (132), 訂閱來源 (98), 摘要 (55), 訂閱源 (29) and others. 訂閱來源 is unambiguous in Taiwan, parallels the Simplified 订阅源, and does not collide with Facebook's 動態消息 or with 摘要 (summary, used for Brief/summaries). Counter: N 個訂閱來源. RSS feed → RSS 訂閱來源 (RSS 來源 tolerated in prose). Feed view → 訂閱來源檢視. 摘要 used for a feed is flagged medium because NewsBlur also has summaries; the other synonyms are low. Verifier: when the verb 訂閱 immediately precedes the noun, avoid 訂閱訂閱來源 / 訂閱新的訂閱來源; write 新增訂閱來源 (subscribe to / add a feed), 訂閱此來源 (subscribe to this feed) or 新增網頁訂閱來源 (Subscribe to Web Feed) instead, as a native Taiwan localizer would. Also avoid where it means this concept: 動態消息, 資訊流.
Next unread story → 下一篇未讀文章.

avoid: 標為已讀 (except where space is tight)
terms.note: 標記 is the catalog majority (91 vs 51). 'Read Stories' (the folder of stories already read) is 已讀文章, never 閱讀文章 (imperative 'read stories'). Siri/Spotlight 'Read %@' opens a feed to read it: 閱讀 %@. 'Mark newer/older as read' → 將較新／較舊的文章標記為已讀.

terms.use: 儲存 / 已儲存的文章
terms.note: Unsave → 取消儲存. Also avoid where it means this concept: 保存.

terms.use: 分享 / 已分享 / 分享的文章
terms.note: Shared Stories → 分享的文章.
Product name kept in Latin script with a capital B; Chinese has no plural.
Train → 訓練; Intelligence Training → 智慧訓練; Train this site/story → 訓練此網站／這篇文章; Story trainer → 文章訓練器; Train intelligence → 訓練智慧分類器 is tolerated. Also avoid where it means this concept: 智慧功能.

avoid: 專注 (collides with iOS 專注模式, the system Focus feature)
terms.note: Catalog plurality. The slider is 全部 / 未讀 / 焦點; Focus stories → 焦點文章; Focus view/mode → 焦點檢視／焦點模式; Unread + Focus → 未讀 + 焦點. The plain verb 'focus on what matters' may stay 專注於 in prose.

avoid: 讚 / 倒讚 for the classifier states
terms.note: Super dislike → 超級不喜歡 (catalog plurality). Thumbs up/down in marketing prose may stay 按讚/按倒讚. The trainer's 'beats' means Like outranks Dislike: 喜歡勝過不喜歡 or 喜歡 > 不喜歡.

avoid: 分類條件 (for the classifier itself)
terms.note: Prompt classifier → 提示分類器; Regex classifiers → 正規表示式分類器.

terms.use: Premium / Premium Archive / Premium Pro / Archive / Pro
avoid: 從封存方案升級 (for the Archive plan)
terms.note: The catalog keeps the plan names in Latin most of the time (Premium Archive 33 of 56, Premium Pro 22 of 23, Premium about 55 of 76), which reads like YouTube Premium in Taiwan. Lowercase generic 'premium feature/account' → 進階功能 / 付費功能 / 進階帳戶 is fine. The story archive itself (not the plan) is 封存; avoid 典藏, 存檔, 歸檔 for it.
Preferences → 偏好設定 on all platforms; Settings → 設定.
Paying premium subscribers → 付費訂閱者 is fine.
Catalog plurality. Lowercase 'your river' → 新聞流.

avoid: 網站的所有文章 (reads as 'all stories of the site')
terms.note: It is the river of every subscribed site, not all stories of one site.
Taiwan standard and catalog majority.

avoid: 每日摘要 (摘要 is summary)
terms.note: Catalog majority (簡報 76 vs 摘要 36). The briefing's 'summary' stays 摘要; 'Brief' (a summary length) → 簡短. Verifier: the briefing writing styles are 重點條列 (Bullets), 敘事 (Editorial, the flowing narrative style) and 標題 (Headlines).
Tag RSS feed → 標籤 RSS 訂閱來源.
Email Newsletters → 電子報.

terms.use: 追蹤 / 追蹤者 / 朋友
terms.note: I'm Following → 我追蹤的人; Following Me → 追蹤我的人 (must be distinguishable). Ask AI follow-up → 追問.
Catalog majority (35 vs 2) and Taiwan social apps' term for muting.
Sites that publish rarely, not sites the reader rarely sees. In prose 不常更新的網站 is fine.

terms.concept: Good Reads / Long Reads / Widely Read
terms.use: 優質閱讀 / 長篇閱讀 / 廣受閱讀的文章
avoid: 熱門文章 (that is Top stories)
terms.note: Good Reads is a folder of good stories, not books. Long Reads → 長篇閱讀 (長篇文章 tolerated in 'Show Long Reads' style labels).
Global → 全域 elsewhere (global classifiers, global settings).

terms.use: 訂閱來源檢視 / 文字檢視 / 文章檢視 / 原始網站檢視 (原始檢視 tolerated)
terms.note: Original site → 原始網站.
In prose the feature name may be quoted as 「詢問 AI」. Full sentences like 向 AI 提問 are fine when not the feature name. Also avoid where it means this concept: AI 詢問.

terms.use: 帳戶 / 登入 / 登出 / 註冊 / 建立帳戶
terms.note: 帳戶 is the catalog majority (104 vs 1). User → 使用者.

terms.use: 試用 / 升級 / 續訂
鍵盤快速鍵 / 快速鍵
terms.note: Apple and Microsoft Taiwan use 快速鍵. Android app shortcuts (launcher) stay 捷徑.
Follows the feed term.

terms.use: 文章分群 / 分群 (a cluster: 群組)
terms.note: Catalog majority is 分群.

terms.use: 檔案, 設定, 資料夾, 訊息, 網路, 影片, 程式, 使用者, 預設, 支援, 搜尋, 列印, 螢幕, 視窗, 連結, 伺服器
avoid: 支持 (for a feature supporting something)
terms.note: Flag Simplified-Chinese vocabulary or characters as terminology/untranslated. Also avoid where it means this concept: 用戶.

terms.use: Full-width ，。：；？！（） in Chinese text; Taiwan quotes 「」 and nested 『』; one space between Chinese and Latin words, numbers and placeholders; no space next to full-width punctuation; ellipsis …
avoid: missing space around Latin words or placeholders
terms.note: Apple-style single … in menus and progress labels; …… is tolerated in prose. ASCII punctuation inside code, URLs or placeholders is left alone.
